sources: https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/26 (US eDirect API floridardr.usedirect.com: search/place for PlaceId 26, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 63 Loop A, 64 Loop B, 65 Loop C, 66 Loop D, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/henderson-beach-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The sites have water, electricity (all sites have both 30 and 50-amp service)', 'All campsites have sewage hook-ups') + Reserve Florida unit details (Electric Hookup 30 or 50, Water Hookup on every unit), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Four loops, a mixture of back-in and pull-through sites. Reserve Florida lists 54 web-bookable units, 52 for RVs (30-60 ft) and two tent-only buddy sites (28, 29); its descriptions give Loop A and much of Loop B 30-amp maximum service, although the park page says every site has 30 and 50 amp.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/henderson-beach-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The park has 60 campsites that can accommodate either tents or RVs, with a mixture of back-in and pull-through sites', 'Maximum RV length = 60 feet') + Reserve Florida search/details for facilities 63-66 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName, 'MAXIMUM AMPS: 30'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/henderson-beach-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The campgrounds have heated and air-conditioned restrooms with showers') + Reserve Florida unit descriptions ('50-200 feet to restroom and laundry'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/henderson-beach-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 60 RV/tent sites to 60 ft with pull-throughs, 50-amp electric, water and sewer at every site, restrooms with showers and laundry, reservable on Reserve Florida 11 months ahead. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; every unit still $30 + utility). fcfs, season and stay limits left inherited/unstated. Note unchanged (AWH's setting text).
